name: Song Cau grilled chicken
summary: Chicken cut into wings and thighs, marinated with onion, pepper, chilli, garlic, and fish sauce, and grilled over charcoal. It comes with at least five dipping salts.
origin: Phu Yen. Sông Cầu, on Du lịch Phú Yên’s 29 December 2020 note.
howToEat: Cutting the bird wing by wing and thigh by thigh lets the meat take the marinade. Four of the salts are muối tiêu vắt chanh, muối ớt giã lá chanh, muối ớt xanh giã nhuyễn, and muối ớt đỏ.
seoTitle: Song Cau grilled chicken — charcoal and five salts
seoDescription: Wings and thighs marinated and grilled over charcoal in Song Cau, with at least five dipping salts.
culture: Tổ chức Kỷ lục Việt Nam put it, with the tuna eye, in a Top 100 of Vietnamese dishes.
